revision: P1D.0a — separates task objective/integrity/coverage; renames 'critical' cells to 'hard-gated'; resolves non-invertibility terminology conflict with need spec per external review
authority: P1D.0 — draft for user review. NOT frozen. No gate closed.
description: Cross-product of the six task families against the six ranked risks. v1.1 changes: (1) each task now has an explicit task_objective / primary_integrity_risk / primary_coverage_risk triple, so the evidence_retrieval conflation is resolved; (2) the defining-risk cells are renamed from 'critical' to 'hard_gated', matching the need spec's task_hard_gated concept (frozen absolute threshold + allowed paired regression margin, NOT zero-tolerance); (3) false_support remains the only globally_non_compensable risk, distinct from the hard-gated cells.

terminology_alignment_with_need_spec.globally_non_compensable: false_support only. A material regression fails the product gate regardless of macro gains.
terminology_alignment_with_need_spec.hard_gated: the task's defining risk. Candidate must meet the frozen absolute threshold AND remain within the allowed paired regression margin. NOT zero-tolerance; thresholds frozen at P1D.6.
terminology_alignment_with_need_spec.former_v1_term_critical: renamed to hard_gated in v1.1. The v1 'critical' label implied the same thing as the need-spec 'non-invertible', causing the contradiction.

severity_meaning.not_applicable: Risk does not arise for this task family.
severity_meaning.low: Risk arises but is low-cost and usually self-correcting.
severity_meaning.medium: Risk is material and must be measured; small regressions tolerable if compensated.
severity_meaning.high: Risk is material and a regression is disqualifying unless clearly offset elsewhere in the SAME task.
severity_meaning.hard_gated: This is the task's defining risk (or, for false_support, the globally non-compensable risk). Candidate must meet the frozen absolute threshold AND remain within the allowed paired regression margin. Thresholds frozen at P1D.6.

task_axes_summary.description: The three-axis definition per task, lifted from the need spec so the matrix is self-contained.

evidence_retrieval.objective: Retrieve a passage supporting a claim.

task_axes_summary.evidence_retrieval_conflation_fix_note: v1 listed 'missing supporting evidence' as the table primary risk AND false_support as the critical cell for evidence_retrieval, which read as a contradiction. v1.1 splits cleanly: task OBJECTIVE = retrieve supporting evidence (coverage); defining INTEGRITY risk = false support. Coverage and integrity are different axes.

false_support.failure_mode: A topically-similar paper is returned as relevant but does not actually address the question.

missed_contradiction.failure_mode: Contradictions are usually sought separately in evidence/contradiction tasks, not discovery.

agenda_mismatch.failure_mode: Broad topic search returns adjacent-agenda papers.

missed_relevant_evidence.failure_mode: The defining coverage failure: a relevant paper is missing from the result set.

redundancy.failure_mode: Near-duplicate papers crowd out diverse results.

latency_resource_cost.failure_mode: Discovery is interactive; latency must stay within the interactive budget.

false_support.failure_mode: The defining integrity failure AND the globally non-compensable risk: a passage appears to support a claim but does not. Researcher builds on false evidence.

missed_contradiction.failure_mode: Contradictions are handled by the contradiction_retrieval task, not this one.

agenda_mismatch.failure_mode: Passage is topically similar but addresses a different intervention/outcome.

missed_relevant_evidence.failure_mode: The supporting passage (coverage goal) is not retrieved.

latency_resource_cost.failure_mode: Evidence retrieval is often batched; latency budget is looser than discovery.

false_support.failure_mode: A passage is returned as contradicting but does not actually contradict (strawman).

missed_contradiction.failure_mode: The defining integrity failure: a real contradicting/qualifying result is missed.

agenda_mismatch.failure_mode: Contradiction is about a different population/intervention.

missed_relevant_evidence.failure_mode: Synonymous with missed_contradiction for this task.

latency_resource_cost.failure_mode: Typically batched; latency budget is looser.

false_support.failure_mode: An application paper is returned as if it were a method paper.

missed_contradiction.failure_mode: Out of scope for method retrieval.

agenda_mismatch.failure_mode: The defining integrity failure: a different method with the same name/family is returned as the method sought.

missed_relevant_evidence.failure_mode: The actual method paper is missing.

false_support.failure_mode: A paper is included in the synthesis set but doesn't actually support the synthesis.

missed_contradiction.failure_mode: A contradicting lineage is excluded, biasing the synthesis.

missed_relevant_evidence.failure_mode: An entire relevant lineage is absent.

redundancy.failure_mode: The defining integrity failure: redundant results crowd out diverse evidence, inflating perceived breadth.
redundancy.metric_proxy: unique relevant papers@10, source diversity, duplicate-result rate

latency_resource_cost.failure_mode: Synthesis is batched and async; latency budget is loosest.

false_support.failure_mode: A paper is treated as addressing the gap when it studies a different agenda.

missed_contradiction.failure_mode: A paper showing the gap is smaller/larger than believed is missed.

agenda_mismatch.failure_mode: The defining integrity failure: confusing broad topical similarity with the same research question.
agenda_mismatch.metric_proxy: agenda-mismatch rate, precision@5 on PICO queries

missed_relevant_evidence.failure_mode: A paper directly addressing the gap is absent.

redundancy.failure_mode: Same lab/lineage papers crowd the gap view.

hard_gated_cells_summary.description: These (task, risk) cells are hard-gated: candidate must meet the frozen absolute threshold AND remain within the allowed paired regression margin. Thresholds/margins frozen at P1D.6. NOT zero-tolerance.
hard_gated_cells_summary.note_v1_1: v1 called these 'critical' and counted 5, which conflicted with the need-spec statement that false_support is the only non-invertible risk. v1.1 renames them 'hard_gated' (the task-specific concept) and counts 6: paper_discovery/missed_relevant_evidence was hard-gated in the matrix but not listed in v1's critical summary — added. evidence_retrieval/false_support is BOTH hard-gated (task-level) AND globally non-compensable (the only risk with global status).

globally_non_compensable_cells.description: Only false_support. Any material regression here fails the product gate regardless of macro gains, regardless of task.
globally_non_compensable_cells.rule: false_support is globally non-compensable across all tasks where it appears, not just where it is the defining risk.
